paper-boundary.why: Connecting a real venue's feed weakens the simulated-only feed layer; FEED_VARIABLE stays exactly 'simulated' and any change is the owner's with an ADR.

paper-boundary.item: Any withdrawal, redemption payment or custodian call
paper-boundary.why: ADR 0021 and ADR 0023 refuse the withdrawal half of treasury; a notice records a claim and moves nothing.
